title: Sharp Yamabe Bounds for Spherical Three-Space Forms via Four-Dimensional Poincaré--Einstein Compactness
summary: Let $Γ<SO(4)$ be a nontrivial finite group acting freely on $S^3$, and let $M=S^3/Γ$. We prove that every smooth conformal class $C$ on $M$ satisfies \[ Y(M,C)\le |Γ|^{-2/3}Y(S^3), \] with equality for the quotient-round conformal class. Consequently, \[ σ(M)=|Γ|^{-2/3}Y(S^3). \] Our approach uses four-dimensional Poincaré--Einstein fillings of the ball. We first establish compactness for fillings whose conformal infinities range over a compact family of positive-scalar-curvature metrics.
